text_block_list.text:
Even after class ended, Transcend didn't 
come to the Trainer's room. She had left a 
note and set off on a journey to connect 
with people from all over.

Tracking Transcend down using the hints, 
she explained that gathering info through 
casual chats about hobbies was the key to 
unlocking a "thrilling run."

However, that alone wouldn't win races. On 
the promise that she would train 
diligently as well, the Trainer allowed 
her time to socialize.
